description: This file contains React components for the marketing pages of a web application, including navigation, hero section, stats, and footer. It defines UI components for the landing page of a document management platform called DocumentHub.

methods.name: MarketingNav
methods.description: Top navigation component for the landing page, including logo, navigation links, and sign-in/signup buttons.

methods.name: NavLink
methods.description: Internal component for navigation links with animated underline on hover.

methods.name: MarketingHero
methods.description: Hero section for the landing page with headline, description, call-to-action buttons, stats, and illustrations.

methods.name: Stat
methods.description: Reusable component displaying a statistic with an icon, label, and value.

methods.name: MarketingFooter
methods.description: Simple footer component with branding, links, and copyright information.
